string: ASH Glo uses the camera so you can photograph or film your work for your storefront portfolio.
ASH Glo needs access to your photos so you can upload portfolio images and a profile picture.
ASH Glo saves receipts and shared images to your photo library when you ask it to.
ASH Glo uses the microphone when you record a video of your service for your portfolio.
ASH Glo uses your location to show verified providers near you. You can also type your city instead.
ASH Glo can use Face ID to unlock your wallet and payout details.
